svg.title: Specimen Cabinet — music video style reference (c3-specimen-cabinet)
svg.desc: A walnut specimen drawer that fills as the song names things — every noun a specimen on its own card, lit when it is sung. Frame is 1600x900; the strip below the frame is apparatus, not part of the film.
svg.text: SECTION VARIATION — THE SAME STYLE AT FIVE POINTS IN THE SONG
An empty drawer and its engraved brass
nameplate. The band name leaves with it.

g.text: THE GODS HID ABOUT WHEN THEY MADE
THE GODS HID ABOUT WHEN THEY MADE

svg.text: The drawer fills a card at a time. Only the

g.text: SO I'M RUNNING INTO THE WILD
SO I'M RUNNING INTO THE WILD

svg.text: The dividers are down and the back of the
drawer is open. The specimens got out.
No placard. The drawer becomes an instrument
case; the lid label is the only type.

g.text: I MEAN GLACIERS AND GARDENS AND GROTTOS
I MEAN GLACIERS AND GARDENS AND GROTTOS

svg.text: Glaciers, gardens, grottos: three cards lit on
their own three words. Gold is crossed out.
